statement: let liouville := fun n : ℕ => (-1:ℤ)^n.primeFactorsList.length; Nat.Prime 97 ∧ Nat.Prime 103 ∧ Nat.Prime 67 ∧ Nat.Prime 7 ∧ Nat.Prime 19 ∧ 133 = 7*19 ∧ 97+103=200 ∧ 67+133=200 ∧ (∀ x ∈ ({97,103,67,133} : Finset ℕ), 200 ≤ 3*x ∧ 3*x ≤ 400) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, m ∣ 30 → ∀ F : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ, F (97%m) (103%m)=F (67%m) (133%m)) ∧ liouville 97 * liouville 103 = 1 ∧ liouville 67 * liouville 133 = -1

plain_statement.en: New route · Characters and extended arcs · CW-8009 · Check two central pairs with identical residue data and different factor parity

brief.zh: 检验 200 的两组分解并把模 30 的同余降到每个因子模数。可作为有限余类测试的反例。进一步的 Theta 测试须提供额外的双变量输入。
brief.en: Check both pairs and reduce the congruences modulo 30 to each divisor of 30. This is a finite test for residue-based models. A theta model needs extra two-variable data.
